Associations.Title: File associations
Associations.Subtitle: Optional settings for the current Windows user.
Associations.Source: Register .vs to run with this Runtime (with file icon)
Associations.Application: Register .vsapp to run with this Runtime (with file icon)
Associations.PackageIcon: Register the .vspkg icon if no icon is already registered
Associations.ChooseDefaults: Choose default apps in Windows Settings after installation
Associations.Description: Opening .vs or .vsapp runs the file. The .vspkg option only adds an icon. Existing defaults stay under your control; Windows may use the selected app's icon.
Associations.Review: Run handlers: {0}. Package icon: {1}. Disabled options only remove settings owned by this installation.
Associations.DefaultReview: Choose .vs and .vsapp default apps in Windows Settings after installation.
Associations.Remove: Remove only this installation's owned handlers and icon references; preserve other apps and later user changes.
Associations.Preserved: Some registration values belong to another installation or were changed. They have been preserved.
Associations.DefaultRequested: Default app settings have been requested. Select this Runtime for .vs and/or .vsapp in Windows to confirm your choice.
Associations.DefaultFailed: Installation succeeded, but Windows Settings could not be opened. Use Settings > Apps > Default apps, or try the button below.
Associations.DefaultUnavailable: Installation succeeded. A complete run handler could not be registered without replacing existing changes; default app settings were not opened.
